                                      "Game stopped early."))))
      (object (cons "result" result)
              (cons "rounds" idx)
              (cons "guesses" (->arr guesses)))))

                     (eres (document_edit (object (cons "id" docid)) rev

                                           (cons "path" (array "guesses" (number->string (- idx 1))))
                                           (cons "value" entry)))))
                     (rev2 (field (field (field eres "observation") "current") "revision")))
                (if (= B 4)
                    (finish docid "solved" (append guesses (list entry)) idx)
